info.description: The Epidotex Syrup Details Management API facilitates the creation and maintenance of detailed information for the Epidotex Syrup product catalog. This endpoint allows businesses to input essential product specifications, enhancing their inventory accuracy and accessibility. Typically used by product managers and inventory specialists, this API streamlines the process of updating product information, ensuring that the catalog remains current and comprehensive. Developers can integrate this API to automate the management of product details, improving operational efficiency.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create new details for the Epidotex Syrup resource. It requires a POST request containing the necessary information to create the details, and it will return the created details in the response.

requestBody.description: This request is used to submit the details of the Epidotex Syrup. Ensure that all required fields in the request body accurately reflect the syrup's attributes to facilitate proper processing.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested details.

epidotex_syrup_id.description: The unique identifier for the Epidotex syrup.

quantity.description: The quantity of the Epidotex syrup being requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority request.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the Epidotex syrup.
